column7: A background from a late-1990s adventure game, Art Deco noir. Flat-shaded surfaces with sharp silhouette edges, no texture inside the shapes, palette of deep teal, black and burnt gold, hard rim light, long geometric shadows, stylised proportions. Subject: a man in a fedora and a long trench coat stands in a 1950s interrogation room at night, seen from behind, only the back of his hat and shoulders visible, no face, no profile. Three open folders spread in a fan on a wooden table, an empty chair, venetian blinds, a single low hanging lamp, cigarette smoke in the light beam.
